item.title: Brigade Gateway
item.description: Brigade Gateway’s excellent sports facilities, including a large pool and multi-purpose hall, make it perfect for diverse learning sessions.

item.title: Guitar Basics for Kids
item.description: Start your musical journey with acoustic guitar! This beginner-friendly course is designed for kids who have never picked up a guitar before.

item.title: Prestige Lakeside Habitat
item.description: Prestige Lakeside Habitat was one of the first communities to adopt Unskooling. With an active RWA and a beautiful clubhouse, sessions here run every weekend.

item.title: Sobha Dream Acres
item.description: With one of the largest resident populations in East Bangalore, Sobha Dream Acres is gearing up to launch its first Unskooling sessions.

item.title: Swimming for Beginners
item.description:
Build water confidence and learn proper swimming technique in the safety of your own society pool.

What You’ll Learn

  • Water safety and confidence building
  • Freestyle stroke technique
  • Backstroke fundamentals
  • Treading water and endurance

Requirements

  • Basic comfort in water
  • Swimwear and goggles
  • Parents must be present for children under 8

item.title: Young Entrepreneurs Club
item.description: Ever wondered how businesses start? This session series takes kids through the journey of creating their own mini-business right in the society.
